facts.fact: 她的全部生活经验是城市景观：混凝土、金属、玻璃。
facts.anchor: My life has been a cityscape, concrete and metal and glass

facts.fact: 童年随 Abnegation 去 Amity，那里的田地规整、作物成行、株间留出能走人的空隙。
facts.anchor: their fields were orderly, the crops planted in tidy lines with enough space to walk between the plants

facts.fact: 这片田野是野的：疯长的草与野花、蓟、矮灌木，还有枝干歪扭伸向天空的死树。
facts.anchor: dead trees with crooked branches twisting into the sky

facts.fact: 枯枝上的乌鸦也转过头，与她对视，又叫了一声。
facts.anchor: It turns its head to look me in the eye, and caws again

facts.fact: 这次恐惧模拟让她无缘无故地恐慌，像一只手掐住喉咙。
facts.anchor: I feel panic clawing at me like a hand around my throat, but I don’t know why

facts.fact: 四周静止无声，但她知道有东西要来，而且会很难看。
facts.anchor: But I know something is coming, and I know it will be bad

facts.fact: 整群乌鸦在空中是一团边飞边扭、不断变形的椭圆。
facts.anchor: an oblong shape in the air that twists and writhes as they vary their flight pattern

facts.fact: 她对自己说「你什么都做不了」，这感觉竟有点像智慧。
facts.anchor: There’s nothing you can do, I say to myself, and it feels, somehow, like wisdom
